flawless: Every island you saw was a gust in my sails. You never found the shore.
I am the storm over Orvada's isles. You were a ripple.
solid: You scattered some of my clouds. The storm still broke over you.
Thunder rolls twice; you only heard the first.
close: My winds are spent. You nearly calmed a tempest!
I am more drizzle than storm now. That was close, mortal.
